nativeRuntimeScope: Locale settings belong to one runtime shared by these sessions
environmentIsolation: Separate Android process/profile isolation is unverified by this prototype
independentTimezone: unsupported; no timezone override requested or applied
scope: Actual official Gecko runtime creation/retained session and controlled local document through production admission, navigation and attachment bookkeeping. Pressure values and pending recovery task are synthetic controls. Android MemoryInfo and current app PID PSS are observations, not physical capacity, ChatGPT, upload picker, native IME or performance acceptance. Session UA and document headers do not establish desktop Worker fetch UA consistency; inherited raw mismatch scope remains unsupported.

userAgentCapability.description: Session UA is observed in main/frame/Dedicated Worker JavaScript and document/script/page-fetch headers. Dedicated HTTP and Blob Worker fetch headers are checked against the independent SDK build mobile default; desktop session UA consistency for these requests is unsupported. The static default getter is not a native runtime acknowledgement.
